snippet.title: Purrfect Stall // Teaser
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4059650/Purrfect__Stall/

Purrfect Stall! Is a game A cosy 3D management game where you serving ice cream and tanghulu to customers and fight off your boss Capymayor at the end of each day. With each day the game gets quicker and boss gets more intense. As you try and keep on top of managing the store.

Developed by
PURRfect Gem
